findings.evidence: She had decided in the car that she would tell him.
findings.diagnosis: The internal stake is declared up front and re-declared at the end rather than emerging from procedural detail. (Note: the character-simulator credits this same move for keeping Lena's contradiction live — disagreement preserved.)

findings.evidence: It was the thing she had instead of the thing Mam had always handed him for nothing.
findings.diagnosis: The meaning crystallized in abstract 'the thing... the thing' terms instead of a concrete image.

findings.evidence: like a cup she didn't want to spill / carried the other version up the motorway / the sentence she had carried three hours sat up in her chest
findings.diagnosis: The carried-secret figure recurs three times and becomes a visible authorial motif.
